# SlideBee Design Studio

> SlideBee is a premier presentation design studio engineered for venture-backed founders, C-suite executives, and enterprise brands. We craft investor pitch decks, board meeting keynotes, and sales presentations with guaranteed 24h to 48h turnaround, strict NDAs, and 100% editable PowerPoint (.pptx), Google Slides, and Keynote deliverables.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Presentation Redesign & Polish](https://theslidebee.com/services): Overhauling raw, unformatted decks into executive visual narratives.
- [Venture Pitch Decks](https://theslidebee.com/services): 12-slide VC-grade investor narrative structure with unit economics and TAM visualizers.
- [Executive Stage Keynotes](https://theslidebee.com/services): High-contrast keynote decks for global conferences, annual summits, and boardrooms.
- [PowerPoint Templates](https://theslidebee.com/templates): Master slide systems built for enterprise marketing and sales teams.
- [Ecommerce Website Development](https://theslidebee.com/services?type=ecommerce): All-inclusive ₹25,000 storefront architecture with 500 product capacity, Razorpay checkout, and Cloudflare deployment.
- [Monthly Designer Retainer](https://theslidebee.com/pricing): Embedded presentation art director with same-day turns and direct Slack integration.

## Transparent Pricing
- Presentation Redesign: $19 / ₹1,499 per slide (24h–48h turnaround)
- Venture Pitch Deck: $29 / ₹2,299 per slide (48h–72h turnaround, unlimited revisions, signed NDA)
- Executive & Stage Keynote: $49 / ₹3,899 per slide (24h priority guarantee, master template included)
- Dedicated Designer Retainer: $1,490 / ₹1,19,000 per month (pause/cancel anytime)
- Complete Ecommerce Storefront: ₹25,000 one-time (500 products, Razorpay, Cloudflare, Zoho email)
